evidence_limits: This public summary exposes measurements and archive hashes. Full raw archives remain local. Hashes are integrity references, not signatures or proof of universal correctness. Passing replay checks alone does not establish improvement.
metric: Raw pass@64: tasks with at least one independently scored correct program among 64 samples. No search-based selection at evaluation.
mission: Develop trustworthy recursive self-improvement for research, cybersecurity, social good and policy, measured independently.
required_evidence: Sustained gains in raw large-k coverage across generations
Later improvers produce larger gains from the same frozen ancestor
Intact inheritance beats empty and scrambled controls
Independent held-out evaluation and total-compute accounting
scope: Completed local research pilots; not a capability of the downloadable LEDGER release or the planning demo.

studies.finding: Coverage rose, then regressed below the initial model. Inherited edit statistics did not beat the empty and scrambled controls.
studies.title: Search, distillation and inherited edit statistics

studies.finding: Replay retained more syntactic variety without sustained coverage gains. The validation gate accepted an update that lost two tasks on the separate final bank.
limitations: 24 final tasks; 12 validation tasks per round
Different task bank from the first pilot; compare arms within each study
studies.title: Verified replay and model promotion
